title: Pandemonium
statusNote: The N-Gage 2.0 game of 2009, not the original N-Gage card Pandemonium! (2003). Plays: the N-Gage and Eidos logos, the trial note (Try Game), the title, New Game, and World I's first level in landscape with correct 3D, about 21 fps. Its movies are skipped (no video decoder in the web build).
notes: The game's help lists A to jump and B to fire, keys the phone does not have: the centre key (OK) jumps, and fire has no key here.
The keypad is turned for landscape: 8 moves left, 2 right, 4 up, 6 down, as well as the arrows.

controls.source: The game's own help screen, and watched in play (OK jumps, left and right move, the left soft key pauses).

actions.ok: Jump (twice: double jump); select in menus
